external_collaboration.partner_name: Young Universities for the Future of Europe (YUFE)
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The University of Antwerp is part of the European alliance Young Universities for the Future of Europe (YUFE). YUFE is formed by ten young research-intensive universities and two non-academic partners, working together as an inclusive European university. They will bring forth well-rounded experts who can face Europe’s challenges of tomorrow.

The Young European Research Universities Network (Yerun) strives to create broader support for young universities in European discussions and to develop innovative initiatives around open science, research and education.
The Utrecht Network wants to share and expand her expertise on internationalisation and to set up mobilities with universities within and outside of Europe.

Connect by YERUN, an innovative digital platform developed by the University of Southern Denmark and YERUN to foster collaboration among its member institutions, was officially launched in November 2024.

network.coverage_note: The evidence provides information on international networks like YUFE, YERUN, and the Utrecht Network, but does not contain a comprehensive list of individual Erasmus+ partner universities.
